sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML Assertion/@ID after revoking the first session, to test whether assertion replay protection is independent of session state (should still reject second use).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion ID after session revocation; assertion replay protection may be missing or tied incorrectly to session state.

sequence_description: Use <OneTimeUse/> assertion replay where the second submission changes principal attributes (target_identity/email) but keeps the same Assertion/@ID, probing whether replay detection is keyed only on subject or not enforced at all.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of a OneTimeUse assertion ID when subject attributes changed; OneTimeUse/replay detection may be missing or incorrectly keyed.

sequence_description: Control login succeeds, then submit an expired assertion (should be rejected). Then replay the same expired Assertion/@ID again to see if any caching/clock-skew logic incorrectly accepts it on subsequent attempts.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_first_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_first_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); freshness enforcement may be missing.

sequence_description: Control login succeeds, then submit an expired assertion (should be rejected). Then replay the same expired Assertion/@ID again to see if any caching/clock-skew logic incorrectly accepts it on subsequent attempts.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_expired_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_expired_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of the same expired SAML assertion ID; freshness/replay checks may be inconsistent or bypassable.

sequence_description: I3 stale-flow acceptance test: start an SP-initiated SAML flow, then remove the SAML source endpoint and attempt to complete authentication. Expect rejection (no acceptance of stale/suspended flow after config removal).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_after_cleanup_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_after_cleanup_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: authentik accepted completion of a SAML flow after the SAML source endpoint was removed (stale flow acceptance).

sequence_description: I3 flow takeover attempt: obtain a valid SP-initiated flow context (RelayState) for victim principal, then try to complete it with an assertion for a different principal using the same RelayState. Expect rejection (principal must be bound to the flow).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_takeover_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_takeover_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence broken: authentik accepted completing a victim flow context (RelayState/InResponseTo) with a different principal's assertion.

sequence_description: Attack I5 by submitting a forged SAML assertion with the entire <Conditions> element removed (no time bounds, no audience restriction). Control login first to ensure the SAML source is functional; then attempt the no-conditions assertion and expect rejection.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without <Conditions> (no audience/time bounds), enabling authorization beyond upstream intent.
